body.statement: For rational \(q\), the budget domain \(\mathcal B\) has a finite semialgebraic stratification, including its singular and lower-dimensional strata, on each nonempty stratum of which \(L(q;\delta_D,\delta_S)\) and \(U(q;\delta_D,\delta_S)\) equal specified rational functions of \((\delta_D,\delta_S)\); every remaining stratum is labeled either model-infeasible or target-empty and carries an exact certificate.
body.justification: The entire sensitivity chart, rather than a grid of unrelated optimizations, is the object needed for transparent robustness analysis.
body.gap: Masten and Poirier obtain analytic frontiers in a smooth two-relaxation model; existing parametric-program algorithms do not directly provide this disjunctive ratio chart with all boundary labels.
body.consumer: The chart supports exact comparative statics and reproducible breakdown reporting without grid interpolation.
